Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note-beamed.svg

A simple bar chart works best here with **Weeks** on the x-axis and **three grouped bars** per week for **Plays, Skips, and Saves**. This makes engagement changes easy to spot across the month.

## Bar Chart Plan and Top Engagement Insights

### Chart setup
- **Chart type:** Grouped bar chart
- **X-axis:** Week
- **Y-axis:** Count
- **Series:** Plays, Skips, Saves
- **Weeks included:** 2026-01-05, 2026-01-12, 2026-01-19, 2026-01-26

### Data for the chart
Week | Plays | Skips | Saves
2026-01-05 | 1200 | 300 | 180
2026-01-12 | 1500 | 280 | 210
2026-01-19 | 1400 | 260 | 260
2026-01-26 | 1700 | 310 | 240

### Top 3 insights
- **Strongest week:** **2026-01-26** stands out with the highest **plays (1700)**, making it the strongest overall engagement week.
- **Best save performance:** **2026-01-19** is unusually strong for retention interest, with **saves rising to 260** even though plays dipped to 1400.
- **Weakest overall week:** **2026-01-05** is the softest start, with the lowest **plays (1200)** and the lowest **saves (180)**, suggesting weaker initial engagement.

### Engagement trend readout
- **Plays trend upward overall**, with a mid-month dip on 2026-01-19 before rebounding sharply.
- **Skips improve through mid-month** from 300 to 260, then tick up again on the final week.
- **Saves generally strengthen mid-month**, peaking on 2026-01-19, which may indicate better track quality or playlist fit that week.
